selection_policy.basis: Reuse the previously frozen pilot where runnable, then add interaction-diverse cases. Selection uses task level and evaluator-private workflow structure only, never model scores.

openhands.browser_affordance: official OpenHands CLI; no registered native BrowserToolSet

openhands.name: guided_vsv

checkpoint_protocol.name: checkpoint_verify
